#html:lead: Under Nova Lima, the documentary crew built a secret laboratory. Instead of drilling through the rock, the new "probe" folds space: it opens two portals linked to each other. Go through the six test chambers — and, in the last one, cross the Earth. Or take on the classic test suite: twelve tests every portal lab runs, from the first button to the furnace. 🦖 Careful: the lab is full of dinosaurs (in helmets).
#html:rules: Portals only open on light concrete (not on rock, metal or glass). Speedy thing goes in, speedy thing comes out. The middle button turns on slow time, which spends a reserve of a few seconds. An original game inspired by the portal puzzle genre; no names or files from other games.
#html:campaign-src: The maps, voice lines and subtitles come from the Portal (Valve) you own, not from the site. Choose the package built with npm run pacote (a portal-campanha.zip file) or the installed Portal folder (the one with the portal and hl2 folders).
#html:final-1: You fell, passed through the center completely weightless, slowed down and arrived at rest on the other side — upside down relative to whoever stayed in Minas. Chamber time: .
#html:final-2: In the real tunnel, 12,742 km long, this same fall would take ~42 minutes and reach ~28,000 km/h at the center — for you, for Dona Cida and for an 8-ton T. rex: in a vacuum, everyone falls the same. The physics is in Part III of the tour.
